phase: Phase 9 - raise safe live tire auto-count without weakening poison protection
new_autocount_conditions: Auto-count fires when ALL hard gates pass (exact app-verified scanned-code evidence, no category_context_conflict, no brand_prefix_conflict, tire-domain in tire context, FULL tire specs, confidence >= 0.90 normalized, customer-privacy intact) AND ANY ONE approved corroboration PATH holds: (1) two_ai_agreement (two independent providers agree); (2) NEW page_fetch_model_agreement - the app's page-fetch result was corroborated by an INDEPENDENT model read of the SAME verified page agreeing on brand + EXACT tire size (set as result.corroboratedByModel in enrichWithPageFetch via crossCheck; never page-fetch alone, never model-confidence alone); (3) deterministic_prefix (strong learned brand-prefix family + full specs + app-verified code). decideDecode tags the winning path on the decision (decision.corroborationPath).

mock_baseline_before.note: single-provider page-fetch; only strong-prefix-family tires (Michelin 086699, Cooper 029142712886, Hankook 0715459) corroborated.

mock_baseline_after.note: 8/9 full-spec tires now auto-count via page_fetch_model_agreement (path 2); only the truncated-spec Cooper 029142815167 correctly withholds (specs gate). Poison still 0%.

live_per_code.reason_if_not: source page lacks load index + speed rating (size shown as 245/65-17, no full specs); spec gate correctly withholds
POISON - decode timed out on deep fallback -> Needs Review; never counted (correct)

live_summary.note: Identity is 100% correct live, but 8/9 tire SOURCE pages (barcode DBs) lack a parseable load index + speed rating, so the tire-spec completeness gate (a hard safety rule) correctly withholds auto-count. Path 2 is proven in mock (89%) + unit tests; it unlocks the second-source requirement, NOT missing source specs. The spec gate was deliberately NOT weakened.

latency.note: Tire decode latency is bounded by the unchanged 13s budget / 10s per-provider timeout; the path-2 page-read corroboration runs WITHIN that budget (concurrent, page timeout 8s) and enables early-exit on a verified tire, so tire p95 is NOT worse (~10s). The 35s figure is the POISON's deep-fallback path (Firecrawl + deep AI), which is pre-existing and unchanged by Phase 9. The budget was NOT increased.
